hook: After years of refusing to do it, Apple finally unveils its *first touchscreen MacBook Pro*
caption:
Apple just put touch on a Mac for the first time. The new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro use a tandem OLED screen Apple calls PROLED XDR, with up to 2,000 nits and a 120Hz refresh rate.
You can scroll, zoom and pinch with your fingers, and the Dynamic Island moves to the Mac for Spotlight, Live Activities and Siri AI.
Inside are M5 Pro or M5 Max chips, up to 128GB of memory and up to 24 hours of battery life, according to Apple.
The 14-inch model starts at $2,899. Preorders opened October 28, and it arrives November 6.
